label: Bible Study
prompt: For he shall give his _____ charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
verse: For he shall give his angels charge over thee, to keep thee in all thy ways.
note: The devil quoted this verse to Jesus in the wilderness — and conveniently left out a few words.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy _____ hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
verse: And he said unto her, Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace, and be whole of thy plague.
note: Twelve years of suffering ended with one touch of His garment, and Jesus sent her off as 'Daughter,' in peace.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called _____, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
verse: And the Lord said unto him, Arise, and go into the street which is called Straight, and enquire in the house of Judas for one called Saul, of Tarsus: for, behold, he prayeth,
note: God gave Ananias an actual street address for Saul: the street called Straight, at the house of Judas.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am _____ that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verse: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
note: Paul says 'whom,' not 'what,' I have believed — and he's sure his deposit is safe in those hands.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a _____.
verse: Now when he had left speaking, he said unto Simon, Launch out into the deep, and let down your nets for a draught.
note: 'Draught' (not draft) is a haul of fish. Peter had caught nothing all night — then the nets started breaking.
